Prevention: Deep summer ploughing to eliminate soil borne pathogen
Apply farm yard manure @ 10 tonnes per acre
Apply neem cake @ 100 kg per acre
Use certified and resistant disease- free seeds.
Avoid growing in areas where root knot nematodes are prevalent
Monitoring: Regularly observe for yellowing and wilting of plants
Observe for vascular browning at the basal region of plants
Observe for root modification/ deformities of diseased plant (root knot nematode infestation)
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Trichoderma viride precolonized in farm yard manure
Paecilomyces lilacinous @ 2.5 kg/hectare to control root knot nematodes
Raise seedlings in soil that has been solarised to kill off the pathogen and nematodes.
Direct Control (Chemical): Use of personal protective equipment (PPEs) such as gloves, mask, goggles and keeping antidotes are mandatory by the spray applicators.
